name: hw12_09_get_min_max_average
description: Test 9. The example of 4.8: (10, 4), (20, 8), (30, 6), from 15 to 30: the range holds 8 and 6; no point on 15, so GetPoint(15) adds 6: min 6, max 8, avg 20/3. Points exactly on both ends (10 to 30): no extra GetPoint, avg 18/3 = 6 (an extra point would change it). Neither end on a point (12 to 28): 4.8 and 6.4 are added. A range without points (30 to 40) has only the two GetPoint values (8, 8). An empty series or a missing key: false. int32 values are compared exactly and stored as float: 16777217 and 1 give min 1, max 16777216, sum 16777216 (16777217 rounds to even, + 1 rounds back), avg 8388608.
